name: l2cap_channel_descriptor_create

ownership.argument: Descriptor, not the channel: the connect handler passes its result to 0xC7FF93C, which returns the channel the handlers then touch at +114/+116.

provenance.source: Allocates 44 bytes with 0xC7EAC14, inserts it into the list at *(owner)+8 with 0xC7EAC34, sets the local cid word +38 to 0xFFFF, copies the two cid words from the argument into +16/+20 and sets bit0 of the flag byte +43 when the caller passed a nonzero le flag; when the list is non-empty it also rolls the existing entries through 0xC7FF378.

notes: Descriptor, not the channel: the connect handler passes its result to 0xC7FF93C, which returns the channel the handlers then touch at +114/+116.
